Top-line: Mid-market B2B SaaS (support platform) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for customer-facing chat agents. Primary goal: consistent first-token latency under 1.5s at realistic peak concurrency with streaming + tool-calling. Secondary: path to Dedicated (reserved capacity) if POC proves cost and SLOs.

Background: product + infra ran an internal spike using open models; noticed jitter and tail latency under load. Legal and IT require SOC2, SAML SSO, audit logs and KMS. Current supplier (CloudGen Assist) meeting feature needs but cost and 99p latency are blockers.

POC scope (agreed): 2-week hosted POC. Deliverables: (1) replay of representative traffic (200 concurrent agent sessions), (2) streaming first-token latency measurement (avg and 95/99p) with target <1.5s for first token, (3) tool-calling demo to ticketing API (sync webhook + async follow-up), (4) cost per convo telemetry with target $0.02-0.06. SE to configure prefix/KV caching and advise batching.

Call highlights: VP Product — "If we can't get consistent <1.5s first token under our concurrency we're blocked." PM requested transparent fallback behavior and same API across Hosted/Dedicated. Finance asked for 6-month trial pricing for Dedicated burst capacity.

Demo 2026-02-24: streaming + tool-calling; showed automatic fallback to quantized variant, canary rollout options. Security kickoff 2026-03-03: requested SOC2 attestation and SAML integration checklist.

Open items: provide SOC2 report, confirm EU data residency controls for EU customers, finalize measurement method and measurement location for first-token SLO (client-side vs edge).
